title: psorospermum lanceolatum
intro: Psorospermum lanceolatum, commonly known as the Madagascar periwinkle, is a plant species native to Madagascar. This plant has been used in traditional medicine for centuries, and its health benefits include its ability to stimulate the production of red blood cells and its anti-cancer properties. The therapeutic actions of Psorospermum lanceolatum include its vasodilatory effect, which helps to lower blood pressure, and its anti-inflammatory properties, which can reduce swelling and pain. The bioactive constituents of this plant include alkaloids such as vincristine and vinblastine, which have been isolated and used in the treatment of various cancers.
